newsitem.title: CANADA: Statscan survey sees July unemployment at 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Statscan survey sees July unemployment at 9.1 pct.

text.p: A Statistics Canada survey of analysts forecast Canadian unemployment to remain unchanged at 9.1 percent in July.
The survey also forecast that consumer prices would be 1.8 percent higher in July than a year earlier.
It forecast real gross domestic product to rise 0.5 percent in June from May.
The economists also forecast merchandise exports for June at C$24.7 billion, and imports of C$22.7 billion.
They also predicted a participation rate in the labor force of 64.9 percent.
The agency on average surveys 17 economists each month.
